## Declaration source (completeness)

The authoritative declaration is **`/bench/repo/proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto`**. A repo-wide search of all `*.proto` files finds exactly one `service ShortcutService` block, with **5 RPCs** (lines 18–51). Generated bindings agree:

- **`/bench/repo/proto/gen/api/v1/shortcut_service_grpc.pb.go`** — `ShortcutServiceServer` interface lists the same 5 methods
- **`/bench/repo/proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/shortcut_service.connect.go`** — 5 Connect procedures
- **`/bench/repo/proto/gen/openapi.yaml`** — 5 `ShortcutService_*` operation IDs

## Every RPC and its backend implementation

All business logic lives on `*APIV1Service` in a single file. There are no other non-test Go implementations of these RPC methods in `/bench/repo/server`.

| RPC | Proto signature | Implementing file (method line) |
|-----|-----------------|----------------------------------|
| **ListShortcuts** | `ListShortcutsRequest` → `ListShortcutsResponse` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` (line 49) |
| **GetShortcut** | `GetShortcutRequest` → `Shortcut` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` (line 95) |
| **CreateShortcut** | `CreateShortcutRequest` → `Shortcut` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` (line 135) |

| **DeleteShortcut** | `DeleteShortcutRequest` → `google.protobuf.Empty` | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` (line 284) |

Non-RPC helper in the same file: `validateFilter` (line 336), used by `CreateShortcut` and `UpdateShortcut`.

## Service wiring (not separate business logic)

`APIV1Service` embeds `v1pb.UnimplementedShortcutServiceServer` in **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go`** (line 29) and satisfies the generated server interface via the methods above.

**HTTP/gRPC-Gateway path:** `v1.go` line 117 calls `v1pb.RegisterShortcutServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)`, which routes REST calls to the same `APIV1Service` methods via generated code in **`/bench/repo/proto/gen/api/v1/shortcut_service.pb.gw.go`**.

**Connect path:** thin wrappers in **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`** (lines 528–566) delegate to `s.APIV1Service.*`; registered in **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go`** (line 43) via `apiv1connect.NewShortcutServiceHandler`.

No call to `RegisterShortcutServiceServer` (native gRPC server) appears under `/bench/repo/server`.

## Summary

**ShortcutService declares exactly 5 RPCs**, all implemented in **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`**. Connect handlers in `connect_services.go` are protocol adapters only; they do not contain separate business logic.
